# Quickstart

Bare CRM is a small kernel for durable CRM facts. Start with the library, then add storage or
operator tooling only when you need it.

## Install

```sh
deno add jsr:@bare-crm/kernel
```

## Use the Kernel

```ts
import { createCrmKernel } from "@bare-crm/kernel"

const crm = createCrmKernel()

await crm.write("person.create", {
  workspaceId: "workspace_1",
  name: "Ada Lovelace",
  emails: [{ value: "ada@example.com", primary: true }],
})

const people = await crm.read("record.search", {
  workspaceId: "workspace_1",
  type: "person",
  text: "ada",
})
```

## Add SQLite

```ts
import { createCrmKernel } from "@bare-crm/kernel"
import { createSqliteStorage } from "@bare-crm/kernel/sqlite"

const storage = createSqliteStorage("./bare-crm.db")
const crm = createCrmKernel({ storage })
```

## Use the CLI

```sh
crm doctor
crm db status sqlite ./bare-crm.db
crm plugins validate ./plugin.json
```
